name: Over a Cup of Tea
source:
You are summoned to a strange girl's tea party. You don't remember anything and she seems to have all the answers. She won't tell you anything!

Will you open the doors to see what's behind? Is it worth it?

[From [url=https://puppet-productions.itch.io/over-a-cup-of-tea]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被召唤去参加一个陌生女孩的茶会。你什么都不记得了，而她似乎已经知道了所有的答案。她不会告诉你任何事！

你愿意打开门看看后面有什么吗？值得吗？

[来自[url=https://puppet-productions.itch.io/over-a-cup-of-tea]Itch.io[/url]]
